reason: I already get phone and WhatsApp quotes from installers I know, and I can have a price today. A site where I wait for partners to send quotes and I've never heard of them doesn't beat that, even if the money is held.
objection: I don't know these partners yet and the first ones are only in Riyadh and Cairo. Quotes that take hours or days don't help me when I need the car done this week.
would_change_my_mind: A price for my exact car within minutes, from named installers with reviews I can check, plus a warranty I can actually claim on.
